title: 彭博策略师：加密资产无收入无盈利，资金转向市场？
speaker: Mike McGlone

segments.en: David, I think you nailed that's the key theme is cryptocurrencies and precious metals have no income, no earnings, no revenue.
segments.zh: 大卫，你说到点子上了，关键主题就是加密资产和贵金属没有收入、没有盈利、没有现金流。

segments.en: And the earnings from the stock market are off the charts. So to me, it's just one of those things is what money managers are doing to realize that cryptocurrencies have unlimited supply.
segments.zh: 而股市的盈利表现却非常亮眼。所以在我看来，资管机构正在意识到加密资产供应无限，这就是他们正在做的事情。

segments.en: They're duds, they're selling every rally. You sell the duds and you buy the studs. The studs, the stock market, stock markets, the only game in town, sure we've had a little bit of a healthy correction.
segments.zh: 它们是劣质资产，每次反弹都在卖出。卖掉劣质资产，买入优质资产。优质资产就是股市，股市是唯一的选择，当然我们也经历了一些健康的调整。

segments.en: But that's the key thing I have from a commodity standpoint. You're going to see continued selling crypto currencies, most notably Bitcoin because there's a better game now.
segments.zh: 但从大宗商品的角度看，关键点是你会看到加密资产持续被抛售，尤其是比特币，因为现在有更好的选择。

segments.en: And we realize in most of them, it's just speculation and that speculation is just getting purged. I think it's the beginning of a purge of there's millions of cryptos attract nothing. We get rid of those and at some point we'll find the bottom looks like we're far from that bottom though.
segments.zh: 我们意识到其中大部分只是投机，这种投机正在被清除。我认为这是清除的开始，数百万种加密资产毫无吸引力。我们摆脱这些之后，某个时点会找到底部，但看起来我们离底部还很远。
